paragraphs.source_en: By this age, Hideyoshi had already invaded Korea. Yet just as Hideyoshi had grown weary of trifling affairs, Ieyasu was only beginning his struggle to unite the realm. This undertaking might well take even longer than Hideyoshi's expedition. Ieyasu could not help reflecting on how strange it was that a man's lifelong labors should never end. Such a burden could never be lifted from his shoulders, not even in an entire lifetime...
